git.title: Git credentials
git.description: HTTPS tokens aoox uses to clone private repositories.
git.emptyBody: Add an HTTPS token so aoox can clone private repositories. Public repositories work without one.
git.emptyBodyMember: Public repositories are cloned without a token. Ask an owner or admin to add one for private repositories.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Channels that receive deployment, backup and health events.
notifications.emptyBody: Send deploy, backup and health alerts to Telegram, Slack, Discord, email or a webhook.

backupDestinations.title: Backup destinations
backupDestinations.description: S3-compatible buckets where database and volume backups are copied.
backupDestinations.emptyBody: Add an S3-compatible bucket to keep backup copies off this server. Until then, backups stay on its local volume.

secrets.title: Secret manager
secrets.description: Connections to Infisical that applications pull secrets from.
secrets.emptyBody: Connect Infisical so applications can pull secrets when their container is created, without copying them into env.

dns.title: DNS providers
dns.description: Cloudflare tokens used to manage DNS records and wildcard certificates.
dns.emptyBody: Connect Cloudflare so aoox can create domain records and issue wildcard certificates for you.

certificates.title: SSL certificates
certificates.description: Your own certificates for application domains, instead of Let's Encrypt.
certificates.emptyBody: Upload your own certificate for domains that should not use Let's Encrypt. Without one, HTTPS domains get Let's Encrypt automatically.
